notes:
Fieldbook 1.4.1: Gantt inline editing, full-height column resize, cascade selection, Years header, noon line in Week

- Today (and Load, Notes) use the full window width like the other tabs
- Master plan: selecting a work package also selects its sub-levels; bulk
  dates and "Part of" apply to the top selected items
- Column edges can be dragged on any row, not only the header
- Double-click a Work package name, Deliverable or Resources cell to edit it
  in place (Enter saves, Esc cancels)
- Years zoom: year row on top and every month labelled underneath
- Week: line at 12:00 and light-blue afternoon cells
- Phone/tablet: opening an editor no longer pops up the keyboard
- More tab icon is now three lines
